important_holds: 14.6 and 14.7 official Ayurveda source title/ingredient/method alignment remains on HOLD.
2.9.11 FSSR is for Dried Ginger; the Ayurveda recipes only name ginger rhizome, which might be fresh. Actual form must be determined before dried ginger/Spices CTR scope is invoked.
CTR lead dry matter source entry 10 mg/kg is not a fresh ginger or mixed cooked-recipe limit.
CTR aflatoxin entries Spices/Spice Mix 30 and 15 µg/kg cannot be auto-used without confirming actual commodity standard, ingredient form and sampling basis.
FSSR 2.9.29 identifies Hing/Hingra as oleogumresin, and compounded Hing differs; no automatic dried spice pesticide/metal rule is transferred to the Ayurveda raw gum.
Water in recipes is process ingredient water requiring potable supply evidence, not a packaged drinking water commercial product.
Special botanical flower/heartwood/root food-use, toxicology and matrix identity questions remain open without blanket exemptions.
The FSSAI 8 April 2024 Spice MRL order is a conditional selection process, not automatic use of 0.1 mg/kg or assumption of complete lab panel.
All new source rows are candidates. Not all original current Gazettes/amendments, 2026 changes, product formulations, methods, analyte panels and reports have been reconciled.
